edition.authority: Congregation for Divine Worship and the Discipline of the Sacraments
edition.jurisdiction: Roman Rite, universal Latin emended reprint
edition.notes: The official 2008 Notitiae notice identifies this as an emended reprint of the third typical edition, not a new typical edition. It records textual, typographic, color, and layout corrections; generally unchanged principal pagination; omission of the Eucharistic Prayers for Masses with Children; new dismissal formulas; and a concluding Supplementum. No exact complete 2008 altar-book artifact is registered or claimed here.
edition.publication: Civitas Vaticana: Typis Vaticanis; Libreria Editrice Vaticana, 2008
edition.title: Missale Romanum, editio typica tertia, reimpressio emendata

work.author: Catholic Church
work.description: The Roman Rite altar book containing the Order of Mass, the temporal and sanctoral cycles, Commons, votive and Requiem Masses, and related rubrical and ritual material. Edition records distinguish the authoritative typical edition from publisher-produced editions made according to it.
work.title: Missale Romanum
